main_text.p: quod Grammatica analysi non sit evo-lutum. Fateor non omnes additas significationes, de quibus in Lexico Novi Testamenti, (cujus epitome quædam est hoc ἐγχειρίδιον ) uberius egi. Obiter tamen passim non solvi nulla dubia. v.g. Legimus Act.12.14. ἐσάνω pro ἐσανέτω per syncopen & crasin: Sed legimus etiam ἐσάνω 1.Cor.10. 12. quod non est præteriti, sed præsentis temporis ab ἔσνμι pro ἔσνμι, de qua re aliàs Grammatica habebimus ᾱσεῖ- λήμματα. Valete viri Nobilissimi, Amplissimi, διεγέρτω magnificentissimi in JESU CHRISTO DOMINO ET SERVATORE NOSTRO unico, quem oro, ut totum BELGIUM, cujus pars haud postrema FRISIA est, ceu exoptatissimum & opportunissimum Ecclesiæ suæ hospitium, incolume, Vestramq; libertatem, pro qua hactenus tam feliciter quàm fortiter dimicastis, porro & in sempiternum, sar-

page.notes: Left margin strip is cropped text from the facing page (show-through/edge), not transcribed. Greek and cropped words in the margin edge are uncertain. Certain Greek forms (e.g. "ἐγχειρίδιον", "ἐσάνω", "ἔσνμι", "ᾱσεῖ- λήμματα", "διεγέρτω") are approximate readings of the scan and marked as doubtful; "ᾱσεῖ-" and "διεγέρτω" are particularly uncertain. The page ends mid-word ("sar-") with a printed hyphen; the continuation is on the next page.
